access.heading: Access restrictions
access.openToAll: Visible to everyone in your organization. No restrictions applied.

skipButton.title: Mark as not relevant (cover page, blank, out of scope) - excluded from the extracted result

reloadButton.title: Re-derive this page from the original document from scratch (re-runs page extraction and layout detection, e.g. column splitting) - unlike Retry/Re-run, which reuses the already-processed image

cancelButton.title: Stop this page's extraction right now instead of waiting for it to finish or time out

completedPage.rerunTitle: Re-run extraction on this page's stored image (e.g. to pick up a prompt change) and merge the new result in, replacing what's there now. Uses the same stored image - won't re-evaluate page layout/splitting.

pageProgress.resumeTitle: Process every page that hasn't been attempted yet - use this if the run was interrupted (e.g. a server restart) and hasn't moved in a while
pageProgress.pauseTitle: Stop the page currently being extracted right away and hold off on the rest - use Resume remaining to continue later

qualityFlags.title: Automatic checks found problems in this page's extraction - compare it with the image, then fix it with Re-run or a manual entry

qualityFlags.overlong_value: {{count}} item(s) in “{{field}}” are very long - several entries may have been merged into one
qualityFlags.repeated_items: {{count}} item(s) in “{{field}}” repeated 3 times or more
qualityFlags.too_few_items: Only {{count}} item(s) in “{{field}}” - fewer than expected for this kind of page

deleteDocument.confirm: Delete the extracted document for this upload? This lets you re-upload the same file without it being blocked as a duplicate. This cannot be undone.
deleteDocument.confirmInProgress: Cancel and remove this document? Any page currently being processed is stopped immediately. This lets you re-upload the same file without it being blocked as a duplicate. This cannot be undone.

export.heading: Export archive
export.descriptionPrefix: Downloads every document in this tenant - all extracted fields plus a
export.descriptionSuffix: folder with every source image and PDF - bundled into one zip file.

integrity.heading: Fixity / integrity check
integrity.description: Verifies every document's file(s) and every file version still exist on disk and still match their hashes, and that the audit log's hash chain is intact. Runs automatically on a weekly schedule - use this to run it on demand.
integrity.failuresNotePrefix: Failures are logged to the Audit Log as
integrity.chainBroken: The audit log has been tampered with

chainReason.prev_hash_mismatch: an entry no longer links to the previous one
chainReason.truncated: the most recent entries were removed
chainReason.head_rewritten: the chain was recomputed after a change
chainReason.unchained: entries were inserted outside the chain

series.heading: Categories

groups.confirmDelete: Delete this group? It will be removed from all users and from any documents it was tagged on.

seriesGrants.heading: Category access
seriesGrants.description: Restrict every document of a category to the people or groups listed here (plus admins and any document-level grants). A category with no grant stays open to everyone.

typeGrants.heading: Document type access
typeGrants.description: Restrict every document of a type to the people or groups listed here (plus admins and any document-level grants). A type with no grant stays open to everyone.

scopedGrants.confirmRemove: Remove this grant? If it is the last one, the documents it covers become visible to everyone again.

filing.heading: Automatic filing
filing.help: Category each new document of a type is filed into. Without a rule, documents go to "To be filed".

tags.heading: Tags
tags.help: Tenant-wide vocabulary. Anyone who may edit a document can tag it; renaming, merging and deleting tags is for admins.
tags.confirmDelete: Delete the tag "{{name}}"? It is removed from every document.

versions.restored: Version {{n}} created from the restored file.
versions.addedReextracting: Version {{n}} added - extraction is running, the fields will update when it finishes (previous values stay in the history).

versions.reextractHint: Runs the extraction again into this same document. Current values are kept in the history.
versions.none: No file recorded for this document.

history.noFieldChanges: No field has been changed since extraction.

sync.allGood: Sync and backups are working - nothing needs attention.

alerts.backup_failed: The last backup failed (last successful one: {{since}}).
alerts.backup_stale: No backup for more than 36 h (last one: {{since}}).

node.heading: This server
node.passiveHint: waits for the local server, which drives the sync
node.joinPending: Joined a deployment - waiting for the first sync to bring its data.

peers.heading: Peers
peers.none: No peer has synchronised with this server yet.

files.heading: Files
files.passiveHint: Transfers are driven by the local server; a missing file shows as "being synchronised" until it arrives.

conflicts.heading: Sync conflicts
conflicts.help: A field edited on both servers at the same time: the latest edit was kept everywhere, the other value is kept here. Confirm, restore the other value or type the right one. Changes that could not be applied can be retried once their cause is fixed.

kind.field: Same field edited on both servers

backups.heading: Backups
backups.none: No backup has run on this server yet.
backups.help: Nightly encrypted backups with restic (30 daily + 12 monthly). Sync is not a backup - see RESTORE.md to restore.

emails.heading: E-mails sent by this server
emails.disabled: E-mail is not set up on this server (SMTP_HOST / SMTP_FROM) - nothing is queued.
emails.hint: Each server sends the e-mails it queued; failed ones stay here until sent again or dropped.

download.originalTitle: The untouched file of the current version - every download is recorded

share.buttonTitle: Create a link to send this document to someone outside
share.title: Share with someone outside
share.intro: Anyone with the link can download this document without an account until it expires. Every use is recorded.
share.audited: The link is shown only once - copy it before closing.
share.createdOnce: Link created. Copy it now - it will not be shown again.
share.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? Anyone holding it will no longer be able to download the document.

exports.intro: ZIP files with the originals, their metadata and a SHA-256 manifest to check integrity. Kept 24 hours.
exports.none: No export yet - select documents in the Documents list and choose “Export”.
exports.warnings_one: {{count}} file is missing or no longer matches its recorded hash - see metadata.json in the ZIP.
exports.warnings_other: {{count}} files are missing or no longer match their recorded hash - see metadata.json in the ZIP.

lifecycle.label: Lifecycle status
lifecycle.heading: Lifecycle
lifecycle.legalHoldHint: Under legal hold: cannot be deleted or destroyed
lifecycle.archiveConfirm: Archive this document? It becomes read-only (only lifecycle managers can still change it) and its retention period may start.
lifecycle.trashHint: The document disappears from every list. It can be restored from the trash until it is purged.
lifecycle.extendHint: Retention has ended: choose a new date to keep the document (it goes back to archived).
lifecycle.holdHint: A legal hold blocks trash, purge and destruction until it is released. Give the reason (case, request...).

retention.intro: How long documents are kept and what happens when their retention ends. The most specific rule wins: a category rule (nearest category up the tree), then the document type.
retention.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule "{{name}}"? Its documents fall back to the next applicable rule.
retention.name: Name
retention.precedence: Destroy and re-examine both make archived documents "to be destroyed" when retention ends - destruction always needs a proposal and the approval of another admin.
retention.runHint: Recompute dates, mark expired documents and purge the trash now (runs daily anyway)
retention.runResult: Done: {{recomputed}} dates updated, {{eligible}} documents to destroy, {{purged}} purged from the trash.

legalHolds.intro: A hold suspends retention: held documents cannot be trashed, purged or destroyed. A category hold covers every subcategory below it, including documents filed there later.

trash.intro: Documents moved to the trash. They can be restored for {{days}} days, then they are destroyed automatically (with a destruction record).

destructions.intro: Documents whose retention has ended, destruction proposals and their reports. A destruction needs two different people: one proposes, another admin approves.
destructions.noneEligible: No document has reached the end of its retention.
destructions.proposeConfirm_one: Propose destroying {{count}} document? Another admin will have to approve it.
destructions.proposeConfirm_other: Propose destroying {{count}} documents? Another admin will have to approve it.
destructions.approveConfirm: Destroy the {{count}} documents of {{number}}? Their files are deleted on both servers and cannot be recovered from the application.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unavailable: {{kind}} - this document is no longer available to you
notifications.emailDisabled: E-mail is not set up on this server - notifications are only shown here.

text.review_pending_one: A new document is waiting for your review

text.mention: {{by}} mentioned you in a comment on {{record}}

text.destruction_proposed: {{by}} proposes destroying {{count}} document(s) - your approval is needed
text.sync_down: Synchronisation of server {{node}} has been failing for several hours
text.backup_failed: The last backup of server {{node}} failed
text.signature_completed: {{record}} is signed by everyone ({{by}} signed last)

comments.readOnly: Readers can read comments but not post.
comments.placeholder: Write a comment… (@ to mention someone)

signatures.notConfigured: Electronic signature is not set up on this server (organisation certificate missing).
signatures.certExpired: The organisation certificate has expired - signing will fail.
signatures.signHint: Enter your password to sign. The current version is signed with the organisation's certificate and saved as a new version.
signatures.levelNote: Simple / advanced electronic signature (PAdES) with SDAI's evidence - not a qualified signature.
signatures.askHint: Choose the signers in order - each one is asked when the previous one has signed.
signatures.notPdf: The current version is not a PDF - nothing to verify.
signatures.allValid_one: Version {{version}}: the signature is valid and the document unchanged since.
signatures.allValid_other: Version {{version}}: all {{count}} signatures are valid and the document unchanged since.
signatures.invalid: Version {{version}}: verification FAILED - the file was changed after signing or a signature is not trusted.
signatures.hashMismatch: The file no longer matches the hash recorded for this version.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Accounts of your organisation: create them, set their role, clearance and permissions, deactivate them. Deleting is reserved to administrators.
users.temporaryHint: Give it to the person by a separate channel; they must choose their own at first sign-in.
users.ownRightsNote: You cannot change your own role, clearance or permissions - ask another administrator.
users.notYourPermission: You can only give permissions you hold yourself
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {{name}}? They can no longer sign in, their open sessions end, their check-outs are released and their share links stop working. You can reactivate the account later.
users.resetConfirm: Give {{name}} a new temporary password? Their open sessions end and they must choose a new password at their next sign-in.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? The account disappears from every list and its e-mail address can be used again. What this person did stays in the history, shown as "User no longer in system". This cannot be undone from the application.
users.movedNote: Accounts, their rights and group memberships are managed on the Users page.

account.title: Change my password
account.forcedIntro: Your password is temporary. Choose your own password to continue.
account.rule: At least {{n}} characters, not your e-mail address.
account.tooShort: The new password must have at least {{n}} characters.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords are different.
account.sessionsNote: Changing your password signs you out everywhere else.

profile.title: My profile
profile.pictureHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. It is cropped to a square.
profile.tooLarge: The picture must be at most {{n}} MB.
profile.emailHint: Your e-mail address is your sign-in: ask a user manager to change it.

extraction.explanation: This document was filed as it is. Extract its data to fill in its fields and file it under its document type.
extraction.running: Extraction running… the page updates when it is done.
extraction.failed: The extraction failed. The document was left as it was - try again later.
extraction.notStarted_one: {{count}} document could not be extracted (already extracted, running or not editable).
